context:
Goal: skip the slow Windows guard shards when a change touches no file the guard suite reads.
Problem (rule): main runs those shards on every ready pull request (your ruling R62, 15:55 CST Nov 12). This lane's change skips them on diffs outside one pinned list (.github/guard-inputs.txt, pinned by lint/test_guard_inputs.py), so it departs from R62. The lane re-points the one test that asserts R62 (lint/test_windows_split.py, ReadyPullFullSuite), as its own commit, under a coordinator pick that is not owner-typed.
Based on (ruling): R62 and own-830-c, which narrows it to a records-only push.
Departs from: main runs the full Windows guard shards on every ready PR — this lane skips them when no guard input changed.
Your answer on item 893 (the daily run for the slow legs) is related and still open; this lane is stacked on #3540.
